head.hi: Proposal by the French Delegation to the Council of Foreign Ministers

p.hi: Statute of the Free Territory of Trieste

div.p: Applications of paragraphs 8(a) and 9 of the Conference Recommendation

note.p: The paragraphs under reference are those in the Record of Recommendations by the Peace Conference on the Draft Peace Treaty with Italy under article 16; see vol. iv, p. 895. These recommendations for article 16, together with the proposed Soviet amendments thereto are included in document CFM(46) (NY) 13, November 14, 1946, p. 1156.
